pearlescent_weapons.name: Jail-Broken Gatling
pearlescent_weapons.redText: Get busy shooting or get busy dying.
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Jailbroken — On hit, gain a stack of Backfire. For each Backfire stack, gain increased Fire Rate and an increased chance to fire additional projectiles.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Gomie
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Ascending Storm — On hit, gain a stack of Firestorm. Each stack increases Weapon Damage. Reloading unleashes Firestorm on nearby enemies.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Herald
pearlescent_weapons.redText: Out of 87 bazillion, ONE of them had to be the best.
pearlescent_weapons.notes: Dataset may use comp_06_pearl_herald instead of comp_05_legendary Export-synced pearl (comp_06_pearl_key+rarity_06_pearlescent).

pearlescent_weapons.name: Conflux
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Sinew — Deals damage per Status Effect on the target.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Soul Survivor
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Adrenaline — Deals increased Damage for each ally in Fight For Your Life.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Crow-Sourced
pearlescent_weapons.redText: And we had to share the rock!
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Left of the Murder — Fires random objects.
pearlescent_weapons.notes: Order AR pearlescent. Do not use crowdsourced/CrowdSourced (that is Vladof Midnight Defiance sniper). Export-synced pearl (rarity_06_pearlescent+itempool_legendary_pearl).

pearlescent_weapons.name: Crazed Earl
pearlescent_weapons.ability: BOGO — Fires Shards that stick into enemies. Meleeing enemies with Shards explodes the Shards and sends them toward nearby enemies.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Eigenburst
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Determined — Damage increases as loaded ammo decreases.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Handcannon
pearlescent_weapons.redText: Dangerous toys are fun, but you could get hurt.
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Click Boom Boom — Sticky Projectiles deal Damage while attached to targets.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Abyss
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Abyss — Increases damage the higher it is charged. If full charge is held too long, triggers a self-damaging explosion.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Screwstonian
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Screwed Up — After consecutive bursts, Fire Rate is reduced and Damage is increased for following bursts.
pearlescent_weapons.notes: Nexus may expose comp_06_pearl_screwed before comp_05_legendary Export-synced pearl (comp_06_pearl_key+base_comp_06_pearlescent).

pearlescent_weapons.name: Parasite
pearlescent_weapons.redText: The obligation of the weak is to nourish the strong.
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Devour — Hitting enemies with Locust Rockets increases Damage taken from Parasite's primary fire. Killing affected enemies with primary fire grants Overshield and refills magazine ammo.
pearlescent_weapons.notes: Nexus inv_name_part Uni_VLA_SM_Locust; editor uses comp_06_pearl_locust with display name Parasite Export-synced pearl (comp_06_pearl_key+base_comp_06_pearlescent).

pearlescent_weapons.name: Solar Temper
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Temper — On Hit explodes. The explosion radius increases with each charge.

pearlescent_weapons.name: Raiden
pearlescent_weapons.redText: Our frothing demand for this gun increases.
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Raiden — On Kill, spawn a Projectile Count Booster that increases projectiles per shot for a duration. Pickup effect stacks.
pearlescent_weapons.notes: Mandolin (Bounty Pack 3) pearlescent. Dedicated ItemPoolList_Murderer. Export-synced pearl (rarity_06_pearlescent).

pearlescent_weapons.name: Sharkbait
pearlescent_weapons.redText: Now, look fellas, let's be reasonable.
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Chum the Water — Every bullet that hits enemies applies 1 stack of Chum. At enough Chum stacks, the enemy explodes for bonus Damage.
pearlescent_weapons.notes: Tuba DLC pearlescent (FModel DLC/Tuba + ItemPoolList_Tuba_Terra). Export-synced pearl (comp_06_pearl_key+rarity_06_pearlescent).

pearlescent_weapons.name: Constable
pearlescent_weapons.redText: We see nothing truly till we understand it.
pearlescent_weapons.notes: Nexus supplement uses comp_06_pearl_constable with display Pearl Constable Export-synced pearl (comp_06_pearl_key+rarity_06_pearlescent).

pearlescent_weapons.name: Juliet's Sparkle
pearlescent_weapons.ability: Starfall — Chance for Stars to fall for bonus damage.
pearlescent_weapons.notes: Nexus supplement comp_06_pearl_juliet (Pearl Juliet) Export-synced pearl (comp_06_pearl_key+base_comp_06_pearlescent).
